blurb: Mary May Charters offers fishing charters and scenic cruises in Casco Bay with Captain John, a lifelong local. Trips include fishing with all gear and licenses provided, as well as harbor cruises featuring lobster trap pulls, seal watching, and lighthouse views. Guests are advised to dress for the weather and bring sunscreen, sunglasses, and a camera.
